description: The live-planning coordinator (D-071): triage thresholds, decision context size, the plan log branch, the launch hold and the on/off switch.

planner.decision_context_max_tokens.description: Token budget of the context one planner decision reads: the candidate, the affected units and neighbours, the recent decisions of the partition and the registry records (design 5).

planner.launch_hold_path.description: Path of the global launch-hold file the coordinator maps to a hold-all in the folded plan; empty means there is none.

planner.log_branch.description: Branch holding docs/programs/<program>/plan-log.jsonl, the append-only plan.changed log, with the planner as its single writer (LP-P1, D-071).

planner.overrun_factor.description: A unit whose elapsed session time passes its estimate times this factor is an overrun input, evaluated when its next event arrives (gate-excellence plan: over 2x stops).

planner.partition_recent_decisions.description: How many of the latest decisions of a partition (program, area) a decision reads as context.

planner.triage_promote_sightings.description: Sightings of one signature at which triage promotes it to a candidate (a second sighting is a rediscovery; design 1.2).
